operations.name: read_device_status
operations.desc: Read device status register from VirtIO device
operations.returns: Device status byte (bit 7=driver_ok, bit 6=features_ok, bit 5=device_needs_reset, bit 4=failed)
operations.asm:
BITS 32
mov dx, 0xc040
in al, dx
ret

operations.name: read_interrupt_status
operations.desc: Read interrupt status from VirtIO device
operations.returns: Interrupt status byte indicating which virtqueues have pending work
operations.asm:
BITS 32
mov dx, 0xc041
in al, dx
ret

operations.name: read_device_features_low
operations.desc: Read lower 16 bits of device feature flags
operations.asm:
BITS 32
mov dx, 0xc042
in ax, dx
ret

operations.name: read_queue_size
operations.asm:
BITS 32
mov dx, 0xc043
in ax, dx
ret

operations.name: read_queue_ready
operations.returns: Non-zero if queue is ready for operation
operations.asm:
BITS 32
mov dx, 0xc044
in al, dx
ret

operations.name: probe_device
operations.desc: Probe device identity by reading status and feature flags
operations.asm:
BITS 32
mov dx, 0xc040
in al, dx
mov cl, al
mov dx, 0xc042
in ax, dx
mov ah, cl
ret
